risks.title: Fluctuations in raw materials and packaging costs
risks.summary_en: Agricultural raw material and packaging material costs can vary significantly due to external factors, directly impacting the company's profitability.
risks.score_rationale_en: The document explicitly mentions that input costs (grains, dairy, packaging) can fluctuate widely due to external conditions. These inputs represent the most significant variable cost, justifying a high severity score. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Intense competition in food markets
risks.summary_en: The company faces strong competition from other manufacturers and private label brands, putting pressure on prices and requiring constant investments in marketing and innovation.
risks.score_rationale_en: The text emphasizes that human and pet food markets are 'highly competitive' with many players. Competition is based on innovation, quality, price, and brand, requiring significant financial and marketing resources. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Strict food industry regulations
risks.summary_en: The company operates in a highly regulated sector, subject to strict quality, safety, and labeling standards, requiring constant vigilance to avoid penalties.
risks.score_rationale_en: Food manufacturing and sales are 'highly regulated' by various federal and international agencies concerning production, labeling, quality, and safety. Non-compliance can result in penalties. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on major customers
risks.summary_en: A significant portion of sales depends on a single customer (Walmart), making the company vulnerable to potential changes in the business relationship or purchasing policies of this customer.
risks.score_rationale_en: Walmart represents 22% of consolidated sales and 31% of the North America Retail segment. Although the text indicates that 'no other customer represented 10% or more,' this concentration on a single major customer constitutes a significant risk. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risks related to global supply chains
risks.summary_en: Global disruptions (wars, pandemics, trade policies) can affect the availability and cost of raw materials needed for production, impacting the supply chain.
risks.score_rationale_en: The document mentions that input costs are affected by external factors such as pandemics, war, currency fluctuations, and government policies. These elements can disrupt the availability and cost of raw materials. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Brand and license management
risks.summary_en: Dependence on licensed brands and joint ventures introduces risks related to managing contractual relationships and the perceived value of associated brands.

risks.title: Environmental and compliance risks
risks.summary_en: The company faces strict environmental regulations and potential litigation related to hazardous substance management, requiring ongoing compliance efforts.
risks.score_rationale_en: The company is involved in response actions to alleged releases of hazardous substances and is subject to various environmental laws. Although material impact is deemed unlikely, these litigations and ongoing compliance represent a risk. (default score, to be refined)
